cited_passage: IRS, "One, Big, Beautiful Bill provisions — Individuals and workers," IRS Newsroom — OBBB permanent extension of the § 199A qualified business income deduction; § 199A is a deduction from taxable income (not an above-the-line AGI deduction), available to both itemizers and standard deduction filers. Source: irs.gov/newsroom/one-big-beautiful-bill-provisions-individuals-and-workers.
